name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep02 - A Promise of Infinite Possibility
short_description: Tim talks about his creative process and brings in other game developers to get feedback on what they would like to see. Later time talks a bit about his initial ideas that will be the foundation for the Double Fine Adventure game.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep03 - Codename: Reds
short_description: As we near the end of pre-production of the game, the team has begun to take shape. And because Double Fine works on multiple projects simultaneously, putting a new team together actually means recruiting from within the company itself.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep04 - Walking Around In Our Drawings
short_description: A creative extravaganza of unimaginable breadth and majesty: the Double Fine Adventure Art Jam. This event saw the powerful artistic forces of Scott Campbell, Nathan “Bagel” Stapley, Peter Chan, and Lee Petty join together to conceptualize new worlds, characters, and inventions.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep05 - It’s Gonna Get Hairy
short_description: A gaggle of Double Fine folk recently got back from an extremely excellent PAX showing, and despite being our first time as an exhibitor at a major gaming event, it couldn’t have gone better.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep06 - That Bagel Filter Thing
short_description: The team finally reaches its full size, and steps are made to address those issues with the help of new staff: longtime Double Fine artist Levi Ryken and two new art interns.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep07 - We'll Handle It
short_description: Things may be looking bleak in this episode, but don’t worry, Tim has an inspiring message for everyone at the end of this update.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep08 - Adventure Games Are Not Dead
short_description: It’s been really busy around here lately, with multiple games shipping in the last couple months, and preparations ongoing for events like PAX East and GDC. We finally show Reds off to the rest of the studio!

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep09 - Broken Age
short_description: Tim is invited to host the annual Game Developers Choice awards during an industry conference in San Francisco. The Reds team crunches to prepare the first trailer that will premier the game and it's new title to the world.

name: Double Fine Adventure: EP10 - Part One of Something Great
short_description: The team is revitalized by the response to the trailer premier at GDC, but a new challenge rears its head that splits the opinions of management.

name: Double Fine Adventure: EP11 - Ship It
short_description: As a plan for release is settled the team is under pressure to hit the date while a mountain of work still remains. A visit to composer Peter McConnell's home outside the city reveals his inspirations and approach to the games score.

name: Double Fine Adventure: EP12 - A Whole Different Game Experience
short_description: Voices are put to the many eccentric characters of Broken Age by a cast of new and old friends. The animation team seeks help from outside the studio to complete Broken Age's hours of cutscenes.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep13 - Crash Landing a Plane
short_description: Peter McConnell's music is brought to life by the Melbourne symphony orchestra. Extensive internal testing reveals mixed feedback on the games puzzles and cutscenes, and stress builds as the clock ticks towards release.

name: Double Fine Adventure: EP14 - I Think This is a Winner
short_description: Audio and visual effects teams feel the crunch on the eve of the release of part one, while last minute decisions continue to be made in regards to the business plan moving forward.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep15 - Evergreen Games
short_description: Behold, the first post-Act 1 launch Double Fine Adventure episode. This one follows the time from the backer release of Act 1 all the way up through the public release.

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep16 - This Time it's Just for Love
short_description: In this episode we explore the aftermath of Act 1’s release, the work the team put into the iPad version, and pre-production for the second half of the game…

name: Double Fine Adventure: Ep17 - Deadline for Tim
short_description: The team is working hard on the new content for Act 2 of Broken Age, but everything rests on Tim being able to finish all his writing tasks under a tight deadline. Double Fine says goodbye to a longtime friend who's contributions to the project will be sorely missed.

name: Kikoriki: Who’s the First?
short_description: Rosa hurries on a meeting with Wally, but one small circumstance destroys all plans and embroils friends. Who will make the first move to compromise?

name: Kikoriki: The Uncivilized
short_description: One fine day a sunflower seed of an unknown plant has flown into Barry's garden and disturbed our friends a lot…

name: Kikoriki: The Forgotten Tale
short_description: Carlin suddenly forgets a story about his life connected with something "big and very important". Friends try to help him "remember everything" …

name: Kikoriki: The Piano
short_description: On top of everything else friends have to be gentlemen. So Rosa decided to test "gentlemanliness" of her friends in a quite unusual way…

name: Kikoriki: Gather You Friends Quickly
short_description: To get guests together – is a big science. One hospitality sometimes isn't enough. You need a lot of imagination and outstanding courage. So Rosa takes up a matter …

name: Kikoriki: The Telegraph
short_description: Kikoriki have a new hobby. Now, instead of visiting each other, they stay home and communicate with one another by the telegraph. Someone need to save the situation.

name: Kikoriki: The Collection
short_description: How is it fascinating – to make a collection! To fill it up with new samples every day! It takes a lot of efforts. But Chiko gives away his "rarities" without any qualms for saving his friend.

name: Kikoriki: Lily
short_description: When the Lady gets into trouble, true gentlemen race to rescue without any reasoning. Chiko and Krash shown their true courage.

name: Kikoriki: The Umbrella’s Biography
short_description: Each of us has things in life with which the set of various memories is associated, and what's a pity to part with them. Wally had such thing too...It is an old umbrella...

name: Kikoriki: Lya
short_description: One fine day Wally concludes that he has musical abilities. But he forgot that less is more. Therefore, our Wally gets into a "story" again.

name: Kikoriki: A Way to the High Society
short_description: It is commonly known that in the polite society it is necessary to follow good manners, otherwise you will be considered as an ill-mannered person. Our Kikoriki fight against their bad habits differently …

name: Kikoriki: Nyusha’s Birthday
short_description: It is very pleasant to present a special birthday gift to the dearest friend. But it is a very hard decision to Chiko to choose a cactus from his collection as a gift to Rosa... He needs all of them … So, Chiko and Krash go to the desert for a new sample of a cactus.

name: Kikoriki: The Golf
short_description: Krash decides to teach Chiko how to play golf. But, it appears that rules in this game are so that Chiko has unknowingly acquainted with it almost all the friends.

name: Kikoriki: Flying in a Dream and in Reality
short_description: Once Pin found a very interesting book and read it all night long. And in the morning he needed to sit down at a plane steering wheel...

name: Kikoriki: Ballast
short_description: Pin constructed another miracle technological wonder – the submarine. Krash and Chiko decide to go for a trip for searching of piratic treasures. But suddenly Rosa joins them. And everyone knows that the woman on the ship is a dangerous thing …

name: Kikoriki: How to Have a Good Rest
short_description: How cool when there is a recipe for any occasion. But what do you do when the recipe book is damaged?

name: Kikoriki: The Beauty
short_description: Dokko, as the fine judge of beauty, decided to decorate the house and to hang a picture on a wall. Krash, Chiko and Rosa come for help. And the work has hummed along!

name: Kikoriki: The Last Rainbow
short_description: Krash, Chiko and Carlin began to publish the newspaper with the latest news. When all news ended, friends begun to invent them – something needs to be written in the newspaper!

name: Kikoriki: Big race
short_description: Immemorial truth: "more haste - less speed" Kikoriki once again proved it during big races for the Desert Cup.

name: Kikoriki: The Magnetism
short_description: "Once Krash and Chiko looked for the dug-in can with carrot juice, but found a magnet. Kikoriki decided to test its magnetic properties on friends’ attraction to themselves…"

name: Kikoriki: The Secret Society
short_description: Krash and Chiko created the secret society in which, as befits, once they have to invite Wally into it and tell him the secret …

name: Kikoriki: Mountains and Candies
short_description: Wally likes to look at mountains very much, but for completeness of feelings, there shall be Rosa near him, but she doesn't like this at all. Therefore she offered a method how to find the way out …

name: Kikoriki: What Everybody Needs
short_description: Once Krash was thinking about an immemorial question: "What everyone needs?" And, asking Chiko for the "advice", he understood what all Kikoriki need …

name: Kikoriki: The Triumph of Intellect
short_description: Dokko's scientific activities are appreciated! He awarded the Nobel Prize and was invited to a presentation ceremony. Kikoriki ware so overflowed with pride that started to train Dokko for the "advent".

name: Kikoriki: The Living Clock
short_description: Once Krash, Chiko, Rosa and Wally were going to the beach. But Wally overslept again. However that was not his fault, but its "alive watches" …

name: Kikoriki: The Sweetness of Honey
short_description: Without Barry's honey life isn't lovely! However such strong love to this sweet pleasure can lead to sad consequences …

name: Kikoriki: In Sweet Harmony
short_description: Once in the wonderful summer afternoon Wally sat down to compose his best masterpiece. But nothing came of it. There was no harmony. Krash, Chiko and Barry helped him to create a harmony …

name: Kikoriki: The Mascot
short_description: Krash and Chiko are going for a trip on a balloon. Wally wants to fly with them too, but it turns out that he has a fear of height. As always, Olga came to the rescue and gave Wally the mascot salvaging from all misfortunes. Now our Wally can do anything!

name: Kikoriki: A Frightening Story for Sweeny
short_description: Once Chiko and Krash told Rosa a terrifying story about The Black Prince of Loveamore. But they didn't even suspect how close to the truth will be a fairy tale …

name: Kikoriki: Little Big Sea
short_description: One day Krash with Chiko decided to send a raft with garbage which they collected on shore in the sea. But suddenly they found a huge dark stain in water which inevitably comes to the coast. By means of Pin they had to save their lagoon urgently!

name: Kikoriki: “Santa Claus” Operation
short_description: Kikoriki learn out that children stopped believe in Santa Clause existence. It is impermissible! Carlin heads the preparation for the New Year's Eve operation "Santa Clause"!

name: Kikoriki: Are you thought about up on the stars?
short_description: Barry finds out that someone trampled his wheat harvest. Krash decides to rise in air by plane and to shoot the field with the camera. Received pictures entered Kikoriki into guessing…

name: Kikoriki: Happy News
short_description: To temper character – is a very useful thing therefore Krash go with Chiko and Wally highly to mountains, towards to difficulties and dangers. The real challenge!

name: Kikoriki: The Butterfly
short_description: Dokko heard a broadcast that all of us had already lived on this Earth. He wrote the letter to this broadcast and learned that earlier he was a butterfly!

name: Kikoriki: The Archeology
short_description: Barry needs to dig up his garden, but alone it would be harder than ever, because rain is coming! Carlin suggested giving this work to Krash and Chiko. Just give them a reason like finding a treasure! So the story begins …

name: Kikoriki: The Meteorology
short_description: Kikoriki have a bad mood: week it is raining during the whole. The scientist Dokko forecasts the weather by means of science "Meteorology", but Carlin has another way to "cope" with the bad weather …

name: Kikoriki: The Disco Dancer
short_description: Kikoriki organized the evening with dancing on which they announced a competition for the best dancer in the disco style. Only Wally doesn't participate – he isn't able to dance the disco. There is only one way: he need to take dancing lessons from Barry, the superdancer of the disco style!

name: Kikoriki: The Soap Opera
short_description: Having listened to Carlin, Dokko says that Carlin has so delightful voice so he can drink soap instead of tea and doesn't even notice it! But Carlin doesn't believe that Dokko can eat soap. And how wrong he was!

name: Kikoriki: The Long Fishing
short_description: Once Barry and Dokko L went fishing, but because of irrepressible curiosity of Dokko, their fishing dragged on a little …

name: Kikoriki: The Repair is a Common Cause
short_description: Kikoriki have a bad mood: week it is raining during the whole. The scientist Dokko forecasts the weather by means of science "Meteorology", but Carlin has another way to "cope" with the bad weather …

name: Kikoriki: The Promise
short_description: Though Chiko is only a child, but already understands that if you gave a promise, then it should be done.

name: Kikoriki: The Pedagogic Poem
short_description: Kikoriki have a bad mood: week it is raining during the whole. The scientist Dokko forecasts the weather by means of science "Meteorology", but Carlin has another way to "cope" with the bad weather …

name: Kikoriki: Farewell, Barash
short_description: What could happen because of one incorrectly understood phrase? In our story, Kikoriki prepared Wally in a round-the-world journey!

name: Kikoriki: Miss University
short_description: Kikoriki hold a beauty contest which winner is, of course, Rosa. But she isn't satisfied with what has already been achieved and sends the letter with the application for the Main beauty contest "Miss Universe" …

name: Kikoriki: Soccer 1
short_description: What is the most important thing in soccer: the scheme and tactics or a spirit and desire to win? Kikoriki will find it out on the football field!

name: Kikoriki: Soccer 2
short_description: Continuation of a match which has ended in a draw.

name: Kikoriki: The Chill
short_description: How is it is pleasant to be ill when friends care for you and feed with tasty raspberry jam! Wally thought the same and took a choice … to get sick!

name: Kikoriki: Dreammeker
short_description: Kikoriki find out that Wally can effect on others dreams, but at the same time he has no dreams at all.

name: Kikoriki: In the Beginning There Was the Word
short_description: Once Carlin has begun to write a life story of Kikoriki, but Wally didn't like what was written by Carlin, and started to write the story by himself. Other Kikoriki haven't stood aside too. Only Barry slept peacefully …

name: Kikoriki: Copatych’s Hives
short_description: Before falling into hibernation, Barry hasn't time to paint beehives. But faithful friends - Krash and Chiko are always ready to help their friend.

name: Kikoriki: The Justice Day
short_description: Pin works on creation of the fireworks production device. At last, when everything was ready, the meteorite falls directly on the device. Pin falls into despair!

name: Kikoriki: The Corps de Ballet
short_description: Kikoriki have a holiday soon, but everyone has no time for a concert rehearsal therefore they have decided to appoint Chiko as the chief of corps de ballet that he will organize everyone.

name: Kikoriki: The Gift
short_description: Rosa dreams that she can has some unusual abilities, for example, to see through walls. Suddenly during a thunderstorm she unexpectedly discovers a power …

name: Kikoriki: The Snatch
short_description: Once Pin designed the gaming machine, but only then understood that it was a very bad idea!

name: Kikoriki: The Clone
short_description: It turns out that in youth Dokko was so ill-mannered that nobody wanted to be his friend. Dokko was lonely, but he found a way out and created himself a friend …

name: Kikoriki: The Basic Instinct
short_description: Once Krash suggested Rosa to play house, but he didn't know that her maternal instinct can awake suddenly...

name: Kikoriki: The  Pancake Week
short_description: Maslenitsa festival – is a remarkable spring holiday when everyone bake pancakes and due to tradition burn a straw woman. However Wally has nearly turned a general fun into the tragedy.

name: Kikoriki: Yezhidze
short_description: Chiko deceived his friends, feels so shameful. Therefore he decides to begin new life in other place where nobody knows about his shame.

name: Kikoriki: It’s Nice to Write Verses
short_description: One morning Rosa redone all her dealings and understood that she has nothing to do, and without them life is so boring! Therefore she went to Wally so he will teach her for his profession.

name: Kikoriki: Hedgehog and the Health
short_description: Sometimes you remember about such piece as your own health. Till you didn't remember about it, everything was fine. But if you remembered, you can’t be sure have you got it, or already not…

name: Kikoriki: Bibi ang His Father
short_description: One night Pin sat on the seashore and was very sad. Having drawn a smiling mug with a stick on sand, Pin had an idea – the plan for Bibi's creation grown up in his head!

name: Kikoriki: My Precious
short_description: Once Wally decided to fascinate Rosa and poured out on himself the whole bottle of Olga's perfume. But if the smell is pleasant to someone, isn't obligatory that it will be also pleasant to another!

name: Kikoriki: The Progress’ Developer
short_description: Krash is very harassed: it seems to that the world stopped in its development, there is no progress! Some invention, which will move the further process of science and technology, is necessary!

name: Kikoriki: The Masquerade
short_description: Winter came. It's time for a festive masquerade approached. Now Kikoriki have only one care – to think up such fancy dress in which nobody recognizes you!

name: Kikoriki: The Boycott
short_description: Rosa urgently needs to meet with friends, but they are busy with an important issue and don't want to listen to her at all. Rosa took offense and decided to arrange a boycott to all…

name: Kikoriki: A Space Odyssey. Episode 1
short_description: Pin is searching for Bibi and decides to fly to the Moon because there was no contact with Bibi… However, having taken off for an outer space, Pin found out that he is not alone on the ship

name: Kikoriki: Bibi’s Holydays
short_description: Pin missed Bibi very much and waited for him to arrive for vacation, and when he will tell about his life … And here a long-awaited day came – Bibi came to Pin to stay for a while.

name: Kikoriki: A Space Odyssey. Episode 2
short_description: Pin, Krash and Chiko fly to the Moon for Bibi saving, but their spaceship is suffer distress. How will our heroes get out of such dangerous situation?

name: Kikoriki: The Nasty Sign
short_description: Since morning, Wally is pursued by different troubles and that’s all because he woke up on the wrong side of the bed. Moreover on Monday!

name: Kikoriki: The Private Life
short_description: Each of us stores something in soul that we wouldn't want to share with anybody. It is called "private life". And whether Kikoriki have this "private life"?

name: Kikoriki: Epistolary novel
short_description: Wally wants to tell Rosa about his feelings, but for some reason he couldn't do this in words. Then he decides to write her a letter…

name: Kikoriki: Plus Snow, Minus Christmas tree
short_description: Once at Kikoriki had a snowless winter and the New year is soon! Krash and Chiko decided to get a fir-tree, which would compensate the lack of snow by its size…

name: Kikoriki: Her Name was Rosa
short_description: Rosa decided to pick up a nobler and sonorous name, which allows to hold destiny by its tail and to make history …

name: Kikoriki: Chiko in the Fogginess
short_description: Krash shoots the fantastic film about space with Chiko in a leading role, but Pin, the specialist in special effects, obscured so much the shooting stage that Chiko got lost in it …

name: Kikoriki: Locked up
short_description: Pin, Carlin and Dokko made Barry a water tank and everyone are suddenly locked in it.

name: Kikoriki: The Line of Fortune
short_description: Dokko thought about tricks of fortune and decided to make an experiment on somebody, having changed its fortune line…

name: Kikoriki: The Truffle
short_description: Barry digs out in his garden a strange tuber. Dokko assures everyone that it is a rare delicacy! The last thing is to choose the lucky one who will eat it and will share tastes …

name: Kikoriki: The Realist
short_description: Dokko and Carlin have argued whether is it necessary to draw in realistic way, or is it possible to dream. Dokko decided to prove that pictures have to reflect the reality of life …

name: Kikoriki: The Anonym
short_description: Friends forgot to congratulate Carlin on his Birthday. Next day it turns out that some anonymous wants to take him away.

name: Kikoriki: What wishes may come
short_description: Once Rosa made a fashionable hair to herself and went for a walk. But on the street the wind blew and spoiled everything. After that, Rosa decided to find the recipe of production of a magic wand, and professor Mendeleyev helped her with this.

name: Kikoriki: The Ends of the Earth
short_description: Once Krash and Dokko have argued: Dokko claimed that Earth is round, and Krash is convinced that it is flat and lies on three elephants who stand on a big turtle. Krash with Chiko took the camera and went to prove the case …

name: Kikoriki: A Run of Bad Luck
short_description: Carlin has a bad luck strip: whatever he does, everything goes wrong way. Barry decided to use it and to collect honey from beehives …

name: Kikoriki: Gastronomy
short_description: Dokko teaches Barry, Krash and Chiko how to cook – how, for example, to make a carrot. However, any tasty dish will seem tasteless if there is no appetite!

name: Kikoriki: Hudini's Secret
short_description: Carlin collects the whole hall of the audience wishing to look at focuses, which secrets have opened to him after a long-term studying of the Tibetan magic. However, he wants to do better and to repeat a unique trick of the great conjurer Houdini!

name: Kikoriki: The Room of Melancholy
short_description: Rosa was very upset, and she needed to stay alone with herself. For this purpose, she has equipped the whole room, which became very popular …

name: Kikoriki: The Vestibular System
short_description: Once Krash and Chiko had fun, standing on the head upside down, but after they have returned to usual position, they couldn't remain standing. Dokko explained them why it happened.

name: Stellaris: Leviathans Story Pack
short_description: Space is lovely, dark and deep, but it has secrets it wants to keep. Rich systems defended by fierce creatures, hostile pockets of resistance to your civilization, and the sleeping giants of the universe – the Fallen Empires who may yet be stirred from their centuries long indolence.

name: Kikoriki: New Year Mail
short_description: Rosa mail-ordered fashionable earclips with hearts. But when the parcel was delivered, she was going to get a very unusual surprise…

name: Kikoriki: The Most Important Thing
short_description: Pin misses Bibi very much, because he was gone somewhere again and did not come back. Dokko thinks that the youth does not have enough feeling of gratitude and that creation's heart loyalty is the first thing the true creator has to take care of. And Dokko gets down to work!

name: Kikoriki: The Lost Apology
short_description: One fine day Rosa has decided to tide up Wally's house: to clean dust and to air the room. But Wally was so frightened of draught that shouted at Rosa and offended her by this …

name: Kikoriki: It  Can't Be true
short_description: One night a strange "weed" has appeared near Dokko's house. After having checked all encyclopedias and found nothing, he has decided that he found an unknown species of a plant…

name: Kikoriki: April Fool's Day
short_description: Kikoriki celebrate the Humour Day – on the 1st of April, but Olga doesn't understand their jokes and explains that it is necessary to joke kindly …

name: Kikoriki: Lullaby for Chiko
short_description: Dokko has read that according to the latest scientific data - marmots, badgers, turtles, chinchillas and … hedgehogs fall into hibernation too!

name: Kikoriki: Without Anybody
short_description: One day Kikoriki played forfeits. Rosa has given a task to go to the wood alone at night. Chiko was this forfeit. How will he cope with this task?

name: Kikoriki: Red Letter Days
short_description: Holiday is the best reason for fun, but if you celebrate it too often, you can be tired of it...

name: Kikoriki: Forget Everything
short_description: Carlin decided to hold a hypnotic session that he can stop having a head for heights…and he gained his point!

name: Kikoriki: The Game
short_description: One day Krash and Chiko asked Dokko to play a game on his computer. However, Dokko was so fond of her by himself so that he has absolutely lost orientation in time and space …

name: Kikoriki:  The Marathoner
short_description: Once Wally lost his inspiration and stopped writing verses. Olga advised him to turn his attention to running. Well, we all want to know how many kilometers should Wally run before inspiration returns.

name: Kikoriki: Our Olympic Champion
short_description: Once Kikoriki decided to participate in the Olympic Games, but understood that, they won't be able to pretend on medals in any sports, so they decided to offer a new Olympic sport ….

name: Kikoriki: The Commentator
short_description: Wally has a bad mood again and nothing pleases him. He was so bored that begins to comment on friends’ actions…

name: Kikoriki: The Good, The Bad, and The Girls
short_description: Rosa tells Wally that the good must be unselfish and advises him to read a book about good and evil, how to engage one's heart and to become attractive …

name: Kikoriki: The End of days
short_description: Carlin painted everything in his house in yellow colour and asked Dokko to let him live in his house for a couple days. At this time while Dokko and Chiko was sorting the library, they found a terrible discovery…

name: Kikoriki: The Cherry Orchard
short_description: Chiko has put a cherry stone so the tree can grow, but Krash doesn’t like when his friend gives all the time to some sprout …

name: Kikoriki: Fear Room
short_description: Kikoriki have decided to open the amusement park in which there will be swings, merry-go-round and a house of mirrors and even a chamber of horrors! Krash and the Chiko have begun to construct this room …

name: Kikoriki: Theater
short_description: Rosa tells Barry a story about Wally, who has fallen down in a well, and to force Barry to listen more attentively she plays it in persons …

name: Kikoriki: The Elixir of Youth
short_description: Carlin and Olga found out that years run so fast and health is not the same any more. But they don’t want to go along with it. So what are they going to do?

name: Kikoriki: The Grandmother Effect
short_description: Barry is going to celebrate the anniversary soon and all friends decided to present him a multi-function watches which both show time, and squeeze out juice, and even heat food. One night something very strange happened…

name: Kikoriki: The Grandmother Effect. Part II
short_description: Mulya and Munya found themselves in the future, and suspect nothing, they are looking for the manor…

name: Kikoriki: The Grandmother Effect. Part III
short_description: Mulya decided to educate the peasantry, but, having got into action, he was so surprised about…

name: Kikoriki: The Red  Data  Book
short_description: Krash and Chiko dug out footpaths in a form of a labyrinth. Carlin was so incensed that, having destroyed a grass on a meadow, Krash and the Chiko destroyed the whole buffalos’ habitat, which are included in the Red List …

name: Kikoriki: Only Mountains
short_description: Wally went to mountains for some inspiration for his new poem. While he was looking for the suitable place, the night fell. Wally came across the lonely deserted house and began to wait for inspiration …

name: Kikoriki: The Vacuum Cleaner
short_description: Pin and Dokko decided to automate the outdated cleaning process. They want to create the program for the vacuum cleaner so it can vacuumed and shaken itself down.

name: Kikoriki: The Night-walker
short_description: Chiko and Krash learn out that Wally is a sleepwalker who walks on a roof. Friends have a great challenge: to hide the moon from Wally …

name: Kikoriki: Forbidden Fruit
short_description: Olga read in the magazine that someone admires the taste and smell of a honeyberry juice. If you tasted it once, you will fond of it for the rest of life. That’s why Olga suggests to forbid a honeyberry tree …

name: Kikoriki: Go and Tell
short_description: Once Rosa fell out with Wally, and Chiko taken offense on Krash. Then Rosa and Wally fell out with Chiko and Krash and Barry fell out with all of them and with Carlin too. What a difficult day they had …

name: Kikoriki: Indian Tea
short_description: If you don’t want to be left without any provision you have to prepare in spring. This year Kikoriki decided to be full only by sun and Indian tea. What is this going to lead to?

name: Kikoriki: Game Will Be Finished
short_description: Dokko and Carlin play billiards. Everyone likes to win, but not to lose. Competitors try to win by any means. Who will be the luckiest one?

name: Kikoriki: Diet for Rosa
short_description: "One day Rosa decided that, she has no waist at all and that she is thick and ugly therefore she stops eating. How long will Rosa be able to starve?"

name: Kikoriki: Ode to a Dresser
short_description: Dokko, Rosa and Krash try to help Chiko to have his own opinion, but what will it be if friends mistakenly intrude their own opinion to Chiko and don't want to listen to each other?

name: Kikoriki: The Suitcase
short_description: How many nostalgic memories appear when we sort out our old things... Barry has a lot of them. Do you know what interesting thoughts appear in the head when you found an old closed suitcase without key - and you don't remember what is there …

name: Kikoriki: Two Magicians
short_description: What the world would be if everyone has the magic power? Rosa and Wally should find it out by their own experience.

name: Kikoriki: The  Sandwich
short_description: Krash and Chiko help Dokko to go on a diet. But can such persistent methods lead to result? Dokko can't assure his friends to refuse a diet and he finds himself a new friend - the speaking sandwich.

name: Kikoriki: Trust in Me, Chiko
short_description: Chiko and Krash set off on dangerous adventures. Chiko unconditionally trusts Krash in his inconceivable plans of rescue and all this make things worse. How will friends come back home if Chiko doesn't cease to listen Krash and his expression: "Believe in me, Chiko"?!

name: Kikoriki: Cartography
short_description: Dokko and Carlin draw the map of Kikoriki valley. It becomes an amusing and huge map because they draw everything they see.

name: Kikoriki: Dolce Vita
short_description: Rosa is a candy girl. Friends presented her the device which makes chocolate. Rosa has done so much chocolate that have nearly flooded the whole world with chocolate.

name: Kikoriki: The Creator
short_description: Wally decided that he has invented the whole world and all friends. But Rosa proved him that he is mistaken.

name: Kikoriki: All Too Figure Skating
short_description: Krash and Rosa compete in figure skating. Rosa plays her number very theatrically and gets the full marks. Krash doesn't understand why he loses to her.

name: Kikoriki: All Too Figure Skating 2
short_description: Krash thought up an act which has nearly brought him a rip-roaring triumph, but at last minute, his character messed him up.

name: Kikoriki: New Year Fairytale Series 1
short_description: New year comes, Rosa wants to meet it cheerfully, instead of Barry who wants to lay down in hibernation. Who will amuse sleepy Barry and play with him in snowballs in the middle of the sparkling wood?

name: Kikoriki: New Year Fairytale Series 2
short_description: Continuation of the New Year's Fairy Tale series. In this series Mysharik appears again. He isn't the fashion designer any more, now he is the director of the New Year's movie.

name: Kikoriki: Ice
short_description: We have a global warming or an Ice Age? While scientists argue it is possible to use pluses of both factors.

name: Kikoriki: Bobsleighing is a Matter of Principle
short_description: It isn't important that houses will suffer during the down-run, the main thing is to leave a hill as far as it possible. Bobsleigh - is a matter of principle!

name: Kikoriki: Hockey Part 1
short_description: Kikoriki are playing hockey, and at the same time Chiko builds a snowman, but because of a trauma Krash has to participate in it too. At first things were not moving, but having realized himself as the member of team...

name: Kikoriki: Coach
short_description: Wally dreams to jump in length, but nothing is working out. Dokko decides to help him, and together they tackle the problem …

name: Kikoriki: Hockey Part 2
short_description: Only Chiko accustomed as the spring comes. All summer he thought and thought and … became a trainer in a new season

name: Kikoriki: Music-Therapy
short_description: How to put nerves in order? How to calm down after a serious failure? Music - is the best thing!

name: Kikoriki: Mr. Window Dresser
short_description: What curtain is better? Light or dark? With this important issue Mister designer will help Chiko.

Sakura is confused by Sasori?s strange appearance, and Granny Chiyo explains that this is Hiruko, the body that Sasori uses for self-defense. In order to defeat the real Sasori inside the body, this Hiruko must first be destroyed.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Sasori's Real Face

Her fervent resolve to risk injury to capture Sasori and force him to give up information about Orochimaru resonates in Granny Chiyo?s heart.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Father and Mother

Sakuro explains to a surprised Granny Chiyo that this antidote converts the poison into harmless protein and is effective for about three minutes. Chiyo and Sakura resolve to bring Sasori down within that time limit

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: An Unnecessary Addition

Tsunade, Jiraiya, Yamato, and Shizune gather in Kakashi's hospital room. Jiraiya reports on Naruto's reckless behavior.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Fake Smile

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Nightmare
short_description: Naruto has a strange nightmare several days after their failure to bring Sasuke home. Even after he awakens wisps of the dream keep haunting him. The next day, Sakura goes to the library to research some medical documents. She happens upon Sai, who is engrossed in a book on human relations.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Wind
short_description: Naruto begins to train with Kakashi. Kakashi finds it exhausting working with Naruto, who can't understand anything explained to him. The only way Naruto can learn is through experience. In order for Naruto to develop his own special Rasengan, Kakashi introduces a special training method.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Squirming
short_description: Learning that his chakra is of the "wind" type that is outstanding for fighting, Naruto puts more effort into his training. He decides to go to Asuma, who is also a "wind" type, for some advice. Meanwhile, Tsunade is being filled in on an assault on a village near the border.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Robbed of Sleep
short_description: Team Kakashi is ordered to resolve the frequent vandalizing of graves at the Fire Temple. When it becomes clear that the vandals aren't after the possessions buried with the dead, Yamato suspects that they want the corpses of the ninja buried in the four hidden tombs near Fire Temple.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Loneliness
short_description: At the Fire Temple, Chiriku explains to Team Kakashi that the hidden tombs hold the guards of the Land of Fire's feudal lord. At one time Chiriku and Asuma were members of that organization. Team Kakashi learn about a terrible incident caused by the Twelve Ninja Guardians.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: A New Enemy
short_description: Word comes that the last of the hidden graves has been broken into. Naruto and the others go after the coffin, but it turns out to be a trap. Yamato can't figure out what the aim of the enemy is, and the team is forced into a battle.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Vicissitudes of Life
short_description: Team Kakashi is split up by the enemy's Earth Summoning Jutsu. They are forced to fight the attacking assassins, but the enemy has the advantage since they know the lay of the land. Sai is shot with a marker that gives away all of his movements.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Contact
short_description: Sora confronts Furido, the mysterious figure who has broken into the hidden graves. Impressed by Sora's unusual strength, he admonishes him, You should reevaluate how you use that power Heaven has blessed you with, and disappears, leaving him with a cryptic message.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Teammate
short_description: Yamato believes that the assailants were not grave robbers but were after Sora. He decides to appoint Sora to Team Kakashi as a temporary stand-in for the injured Sai. This doesn't sit well with Naruto, and furthermore, he is assigned to take care of him as soon as they return to the village.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Two Kings
short_description: By chance, Naruto and Sora get Asuma to coach them. Under the guidance of Asuma's iron fist, they immerse themselves in training with Wind Chakra. Asuma's words soothe Sora and he begins to settle into life in Hidden Leaf Village--until Furido suddenly appears and drops a bombshell.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Jet-Black Signal Fire
short_description: Tsunade catches Danzo in a secret meeting with a ninja from the Hidden Rain Village. But the ninja turns out to be a spy for the Hidden Leaf. It turns out that the four-man group who attacked the graves was actually after Sora.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Lockdown of Darkness
short_description: Under cover of a giant power outage, Furido begins his assault on the Hidden Leaf. The village immediately goes on alert, but Furido's men put up a barrier, and everyone in the village is trapped inside. Naruto and Asuma finally catch up to Sora, who is planning an escape.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Revived Souls
short_description: In order to stop the impending disaster, Asuma rushes toward the electric generator system. There he sees the Guardian Shinobi Twelve who have come to life once more through Revival Jutsu after their graves were robbed.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Everyone's Struggle to the Death
short_description: Sora is speechless when he discovers that Furido not only intends to assassinate the Hokage but plans to totally annihilate Hidden Leaf Village. Sora tries to stop Furido but is hopelessly outmatched. In the village, desperate ninja battles spread. In order to lessen the casualties, the Leaf ninja p

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Moment of Awakening
short_description: Throughout the village, Kitane's fellow Guardian Shinobi with the Lightning Jutsu set up Limelight. With time running out for Hidden Leaf Village, Asuma continues desperately to try to stop Kitane and answers Kitane's question.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Despair
short_description: Naruto and Asuma catch up to Sora, only to find him shrouded in ominous chakra and undergoing a change. Naruto is shocked when Furido reveals the secret of Sora's birth. Ten years earlier, remnants of the Nine Tails' chakra that could not be sealed inside Naruto had been placed inside Sora.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Resonance
short_description: Furido's true form belongs to Kazuma, one of the Guardian Shinobi Twelve who had planned the coup d'?tat. Asuma puts his honor on the line and goes back ten years to battle Furido once more. Meanwhile, the rest of the Hidden Leaf ninja try to stop Sora who has begun to run rampant.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: My Friend
short_description: Naruto desperately tries to suppress Nine Tails' chakra and get through to Sora's heart and soul. Naruto's comrades are helpless against Sora's powerful chakra and can only stand by and watch. Will Naruto's attempts, at the risk of his life, be enough to stop Sora?

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Quietly Approaching Threat
short_description: Work continues in Hidden Leaf Village to erase the scars of battle. As he watches Konohamaru and the others helping with the reconstruction, Iruka sees how his students have matured.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Akatsuki's Invasion
short_description: With Kakashi's return, Naruto resumes training for his new jutsu. Kakashi explains that the transformation training will enter the next stage. This time, only Wind Chakra will be used to cut through a waterfall. Hidan and Kakuzu, who have captured Two Tails, leave it with Zetsu.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Under the Starry Sky
short_description: The lone surviving priest is carried into Hidden Leaf Village where he reports the destruction of the Fire Temple. Upon learning of the Akatsuki's infiltration into the Land of Fire, Tsunade orders the twenty newly formed teams into action.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Old Monk's Prayer
short_description: In order to capture the Akatsuki, the Hidden Leaf cast a net that even an ant could not crawl through. Still, the Akatsuki elude them and frustrate Tsunade to no end. Around that time, Asuma and the others arrive at the Fire Temple, only to find it completely destroyed.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Next Step
short_description: Naruto is learning the elements of Wind Style Jutsu, and Kakashi lectures him on the difficulties of developing a new jutsu. According to Kakashi even the Fourth Hokage was not able to embed elemental chakra into his jutsu.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Climbing Silver
short_description: Asuma and his team finally confront Hidan, and a battle ensues. They fight with all their strength but are shocked at Hidan's power. Kakuzu, the other Akatsuki member, also appears, and the Hidden Leaf seemed destined to lose. Escape is impossible, and Asuma grimly goes over a battle strategy?

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Judgment
short_description: Hidan releases a baffling jutsu, and Asuma bears the brunt of the attack. The jutsu is a special trick which links Hidan with Asuma's body. In that instant, Shikamaru uses his Shadow Strangle Jutsu to stop Hidan's movements, but this jutsu does not last long.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Unfulfilled Scream
short_description: Shikamaru unravels the secret of Hidan's jutsu just in time, and Asuma attacks with all his being. However, even after his head is severed, Hidan continues to live. The Hidden Leaf, aghast at the sight of this undead man, are challenged by the other Akatsuki who has stood by in silence, Kakuzu.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Last Words
short_description: Asuma is mortally wounded by Hidan's jutsu, and the Akatsuki have the rest of the Hidden Leaf in a bind. Just then, reinforcements arrive, led by Ino and Choji. They manage to come to the aid of their comrades, and once again, the Akatsuki find themselves confronted by the Hidden Leaf.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Sad News
short_description: In a faraway land, the Akatsuki reveal their true aim of world conquest. And back at Hidden Leaf Village, Shikamaru gives his report of the mission to Tsunade. Tsunade worries about Kurenai's reaction, but Shikamaru takes it upon himself to tell her the news of Asuma's death.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Team Ten
short_description: Asuma's funeral is held in Hidden Leaf Village amid deep sadness. Shikamaru is the lone absentee, unable to get over the loss. Choji too is disconsolate. As each member of Team 10 deals with Asuma's death, the question they ask themselves is. What must we do next??

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Target: Locked On
short_description: Kakashi and Team 10 set out to stop the Akatsuki. Tsunade considers Naruto's Team 7 to be the ideal back-up for Team 10 and orders Naruto to perfect his new jutsu within 24 hours. Meanwhile, Team 10 waits patiently for the battle against Kakuzu and Hidan.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Kakuzu's Abilities
short_description: Shikamaru and Choji deliver the first blows in the battle, but they are thwarted by Kakuzu's power. Kakashi counters Kakuzu's trick and brings him down. But an unexpected phenomenon puts Shikamaru and the team in a danger. Meanwhile, Naruto is close to perfecting his new jutsu.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Terrifying Secret
short_description: Shikamaru and his comrades desperately counter the Fire Jutsu offensive. But continuously using his Rasengan and Lightning Blade takes its toll on Kakashi. Shikamaru decides that separating Hidan and Kakuzu is the only chance they have, and he sets out to create a diversion.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Shikamaru's Genius
short_description: Shikamaru battles Hidan alone, deep in the forest, and after depleting his chakra, sustains a deep wound. Hidan draws his blood as he lies near death. Around the same time, Kakashi also has been backed into a corner by Kakuzu's relentless attack.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: When You Curse Someone, You Dig Your Own Grave
short_description: Naruto and Team Kakashi arrive just in time to assist Team Asuma. Sakura and Sai are ordered by Kakashi to aid Shikamaru, who is battling alone. Shikamaru knows that the moment of reckoning is near. How will Shikamaru stop the invincible Hidan?

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Wind Style: Rasen Shuriken!
short_description: Ino and Choji are amazed at Naruto's new jutsu, and Kakuzu senses the danger that it poses. But when released, the new jutsu dissipates before it reaches Kakuzu. Naruto's comrades realize that the new jutsu will not bring Kakuzu down. But Naruto insists on another chance.

name: Black Hole Hazard Soundtrack
short_description: The original soundtrack to Black Hole Hazard! 18 tracks spanning over 41 minutes. Provided in mp3 format.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Price of Power
short_description: Naruto's uses his new jutsu to bring Kakuzu down. Tsunade welcomes the teams back home and orders Team Asuma and Team Yamato to take a break. Standing in front of Asuma's grave, Shikamaru sees Kurenai, who is with child, and promises that he will protect the jewel that Asuma has left.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: A Shinobi's Determination
short_description: Just when peace has finally settled over the village word comes that Orochimaru's hideout has been found. Tsunade orders Kakashi, Hinato, Shino, and Kiba on a search mission to find the hideout.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Orochimaru's Hideout Discovered
short_description: Naruto and Jiraiya arrive at the hot springs resort. As an alternative to the Wind Style: Rasen Shuriken, Jiraiya suggests to Naruto the collaboration ninjutsu with a ninja toad.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Encounter
short_description: Inside Orochimaru's hideout Guren witnesses Sasuke defeating a thousand opponents. Having lost the opportunity to be Orochimaru's new vessel in the past, Guren openly express her jealousy toward Sasuke. Seeing through Guren's emotional state, Orochimaru proposes a plan.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Connecting Hearts
short_description: Believing Naruto's new jutsu is almost completed, Jiraiya heads off to investigate new information on the Akatsuki's movements. His arm now healed, Naruto returns to the village to continue his training.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: A Night of Rain
short_description: Staying behind at the hideout, Rinji and Gozu become aware of a shinobi following their tracks. At the same time, Kakashi and his team notice that the enemy is using a bat for surveillance. Both sides are now aware of each other's presence, keeping careful eye on the other's next move.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Two Charms
short_description: At the Leaf Village Naruto is busy training with Gamakichi and Gamatatsu. But when he learns that Kakashi and the others are out on a mission to locate Orochimaru's hideout, Naruto rushes to ask Tsunade if he can join the mission. Tsunade asks why he wishes to take part in this mission.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Unseeing Enemy
short_description: Team Yamato heads out to provide backup for Team Kakashi. Right before his departure Naruto gets a hint to perfect his new jutsu by entering Gamatatsu's belly. Meanwhile, still with no leads, Kakashi and his team continue their pursuit mission.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Labyrinth of Distorted Reflection
short_description: From the results of the analysis of the crystallized Parasitic insects, the enemies currently fighting Kakashi's team are identified as users of the Crystal Style, a rare type of jutsu. Still unclear on what Orochimaru's objective is, Tsunade cannot hide her irritation and anxiety.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Target Appears
short_description: Shattering the force field with his newly mastered collaboration jutsu with the toads, Naruto and the reinforcement unit arrive at the battle site. But Naruto's new jutsu is repulsed by Guren's ability to crystallize fluids.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Rampaging Tailed Beast
short_description: The Leaf ninja use The Bat to pursue Guren. Akamaru and Kiba detect a high level of chakra present at their destination. Convinced something abnormal is about to happen, Kakashi sends Naruto to the lake right before entering battle with the enemy.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Inside the Mist
short_description: Inside the heavy mist, the Leaf ninja manage to rendezvous with Naruto. The team tightens their guard when they learn that the mist surrounding the lake causes illusions. The team discovers that the enemy is after the Three-Tailed Beast.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Everyone's Feelings
short_description: Naruto enters the mist to seek out Yukimaru. Guren stays alert to protect Yukimaru, whose current situation prevents him from moving. When both sides meet, their emotion over Yukimaru sparks.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Regroup!
short_description: Reinforcements arrive from the Leaf Village. The new mission from Tsunade: seal the Three-Tailed Beast so it won't fall into anyone else's hands and take Yukimaru whose powers are tied to the Tailed Beast into custody.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier
short_description: The Leaf ninja wish to seal the Three-Tailed Beast, and Guren's team wishes to stop them at any cost. Shizune's sealing team begins their search as they activate the The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier to trap the Three-Tailed Beast, while team Yamato and team Kakashi stay on guard.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Breaking the Crystal Style
short_description: To protect the The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier necessary to seal the Three-Tailed Beast, Kakashi and Naruto wage their deadly battle against Guren. Sai fights a one-on-one battle with Gozu. But against Guren's awesome Crystal-Style attacks, team Kakashi slowly begins to lose ground.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Battle over the Barrier
short_description: Kabuto plans on breaking the Leaf's The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier from the inside by using Yukimaru's power and have the Three-Tailed Beast go on a rampage. Guren cannot argue, as Kabuto knows her weakness, but pleads for him to give her another chance to break the The Four-Corner Sealing Barrier.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Red Camellia
short_description: To protect Guren from the raging Three Tails, Yuukimaru exerts powers beyond his limits. Moved by his action, Guren now comes to regret her past sin of killing Yuukimaru's mother.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Strange Bedfellows
short_description: To protect Yuukimaru, Naruto and Guren fight alongside each other against the Three-Tailed beast and are swallowed. Inside the beast is an unnatural world filled with limestone. Naruto and Guren argue over who'll take Yuukimaru, when an unexpected danger erupts.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Guidepost of the Camellia
short_description: The Leaf ninja learn that Naruto is inside the Three-Tailed beast. With no other alternative but to trust Yuukimaru's mystical senses, Kakashi and the others follow the boy's guidance and attempt a rescue mission.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Counterattack of the Curse Mark
short_description: Despite the Leaf ninja rescue attempt, Naruto and Guren do not return. Frustration builds among the group, but as Three Tails wakes from its sleep, the Sealing Team makes a second attempt at the Four Corner Sealing Barrier.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Memory of Guilt
short_description: Kabuto plots to have Three Tails crush the Leaf ninja by sacrificing Yuukimaru's power and life. Controlled by Yuukimaru, Three Tails' awesome power is about to break free from the seal, when an unexpected ally saves Shizune's sealing team.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Shattered Promise
short_description: Kabuto finally appears before Naruto. Learning that Orochimaru used Guren's and Yuukimaru's feelings for his own purposes, an enraged Naruto enters battle against Kabuto. Guren tries to escape with the weakened Yuukimaru, but Rinji, who is now under the control of Kabuto, stops them.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: A Place to Return to
short_description: The Leaf ninja fall back and tend to their wounds. The battle has left everyone with serious injuries. Shizune examines Yuukimaru, who is in a coma, but his body is no longer able to control Three Tails. Hearing the report, Tsunade decides it is impossible to continue the mission.

short_description: After hunting down the Four Tails, Itachi and Kisame are summoned by the leader of the Akatsuki. The leader announces the death of Orochimaru to the gathered members and the possibility of his killer, Sasuke, setting his sights on the Akatsuki organization.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Hunt
short_description: Under Kakashi's command, the Leaf ninja set off to find Itachi. Using Kakashi's ninja hounds, they gather as much information as they can on Itachi. Meanwhile, the members of the Hebi also scatter to look for information on Itachi.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Clash!
short_description: Upon encountering one another, Sasuke and Deidara engage in battle. After exchanging a few blows to test Sasuke's strength, Deidara conjures up his specialty clay dragon and wages long-range attacks against Sasuke from high above. With Tobi's backup support, the battle seems to be going to Deidara.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Art
short_description: Determined to destroy the Sharingan to rid himself of the taste of defeat he received from Itachi, Deidara unleashes his biggest attack, the C4 Karura. Created to kill Itachi, this fierce weapon is capable of destroying living beings from the inside.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Disappearance
short_description: Sasuke goes missing after being caught by Deidara's suicidal bombing. Sensing his disappearance, Jugo, Karin, and Suigetsu race to Sasuke's last location, where the three Hebi members discover...?

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Twilight
short_description: With Kiba leading the way, the Leaf ninja follow Sasuke's scent that they picked up from the site of the explosion. But Karin senses the ninja hounds' presence. Suspecting a pursuit by the Leaf ninja, she notifies the others and the Hebi members quickly leave the inn.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Tales of a Gutsy Ninja: Jiraiya Ninja Scrolls, Part 1
short_description: During the reign of the Second Hokage, the young Jiraiya, Orochimaru, and Tsunade are assigned to Hiruzen Sarutobi's platoon as Genins. Fascinated by Sarutobi's summoning jutsu, Jiraiya immerses himself in mastering the transportation technique.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Tales of a Gutsy Ninja : Jiraiya Ninja Scrolls, Part 2
short_description: Jiraiya's journey to seek out a student is postponed due to the outbreak of the Third Great Ninja War. Jiraiya joins Tsunade and Orochimaru to battle the Village Hidden in the Rain.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Infiltrate! The Village Hidden in the Rain
short_description: Jiraiya successfully infiltrates the Hidden Rain Village by hiding inside the toad Gamagoro. He sets out to gather information but finds no indications of a civil war occurring within the village.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Man Who Became God
short_description: Foreseeing a possible battle, Jiraiya takes precautionary measures by storage releasing the scroll toad that commands the key to Naruto?s Eight-Signed Seal.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Honored Sage Mode!
short_description: Jiraiya battles to defeat his former student Pain, who is now driven by his twisted ideals as an Akatsuki member. Jiraiya first summons the giant toad Gamaken to counter

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: In Attendance, The Six Paths of Pain
short_description: Jiraiya completes his Sage Mode transformation to battle the three Pains. But Jiraiya's ninjutsu attacks enhanced by the two great sages, Fukasaku and Shima, are repeatedly negated, while his taijutsu attacks are blocked by the Pains unknown teamwork.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Tale of Jiraiya the Gallant
short_description: Having lost his arm, Jiraiya is outmatched by the six Pains now appearing before him. Of the six, the one called Tendo is revealed to be Jiraiya's former student Yahiko. Jiraiya is still puzzled by the Rinnegan's true powers, but before he can gather his thoughts, he is forced back into battle.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Banquet Invitation
short_description: Sasuke arrives at one of the Akatsuki hideouts, having followed in Itachi's footsteps. When Sasuke is about to enter the hideout alone, his older brother Itachi finally appears before him, only to be revealed as an illusion created by genjutsu.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Longest Moment...
short_description: While Itachi waits for Sasuke in the Uchiha hideout, he recalls the past incident that led to his defection from the Leaf Village. When Sasuke arrives, the fated battle begins between the two brothers. During the battle Sasuke demands to know the answer to his long-lurking question.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Light & Dark of the Mangekyo Sharingan
short_description: Following their fierce genjutsu battle with the Sharingan, Itachi explains the secret behind the most powerful ocular jutsu, the Mangekyo Sharingan, and the history of the Uchiha clan a cursed history drenched in the blood of their struggles for power.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Amaterasu!
short_description: Sasuke loses his left eye to Itachi, but it turns out to be a genjutsu created by the Mangekyo Sharingan. Breaking free of the Tsukuyomi by force, Sasuke makes a furious comeback against the injured Itachi.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The End
short_description: At the climax of the battle, both Itachi and Sasuke run out of chakra. However, Sasuke reveals that his actions up until now were only a preparation for his final jutsu. Using the powers of nature, Sasuke unleashes his new jutsu Kirin against his brother.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Mystery of Tobi
short_description: Naruto and his comrades find themselves held up by Tobi, whose strange jutsu is more than just a simple genjutsu. To counter the jutsu, the team use Shino's Parasitic Insects, but its wide-range attack fails to reach the target.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Fate
short_description: In the Akatsuki hideout Sasuke comes face to face with Madara. Announcing himself as Itachi?s accomplice from that fateful night, Madara goes on to tell Sasuke the truth about Itachi that he could never have known.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Truth
short_description: The Uchiha clan was plotting a coup d'etat. The story as told by Madara leaves Sasuke at a loss for words. Because of his gifted talent, Itachi was forced to suffer, torn between his loyalties to the Leaf Village and the Uchiha clan.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Battle of Unraikyo
short_description: Flame from the Amaterasu still remains on the battlefield as Naruto and his teammates continue to search for Sasuke. But despite the search team?s best efforts, they cannot find any trace of him. Judging they've done all they can, Kakashi decides to pull out and return to the village.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Eight Tails vs Sasuke
short_description: The Taka split up with the Akatsuki to hunt down the remaining Tailed Beast. At the Land of Lightning they go up against Killer Bee, whose attack utilizing Lightning Style and seven blades proves to be more than a match for them.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Wanderer
short_description: The Leaf ninja fail to capture Itachi and also lose track of Sasuke. Calling off their pursuit, the team is heading back to the village when an urgent assignment from Lady Tsunade comes in. The mission stems from a treaty between the Third Hokage and the En no Gyoja of the Tsuchigumo Clan.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Successor of the Forbidden Jutsu
short_description: Naruto and his teammates are assigned to escort Hotaru, En no Gyoja's granddaughter, to the Tsuchigumo Clan's village located in the mountains. But Hotaru's mind is still attached to Utakata, who left after Naruto's arrival.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Successor's Wish
short_description: Having arrived at the village, Hotaru parts with Naruto and his team. But the Magaki Troops are one step ahead and threaten Hotaru to hand over the forbidden jutsu. Utakata appears, and Shiranami recognizes him as a bounty listed in the Hidden Mist's bingo book.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Rogue Ninja's Past
short_description: Yamato and Sai recognize their opponents as trackers from the Hidden Mist Village, but Naruto attacks without questioning. The Hidden Mist demands Utakata be handed over to them in exchange for Hotaru.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Heir to Darkness
short_description: Hotaru is brought back to the fort in Mount Katsuragi. Naruto, outraged to learn the forbidden jutsu was embedded inside Hotaru, demands an explanation from Tonbei. But it was none other than Hotaru herself who wished for this.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Separation
short_description: Believing Shiranami?s story, Hotaru writes a parting letter addressed to Utakata and leaves Mount Katsuragi. Meanwhile Naruto, still searching for Shiranami, falls into the Magaki Troops' trap but manages to escape thanks to help from Utakata.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Forbidden Jutsu Released
short_description: Naruto and Utakata successfully enter the Tsuchigumo village thanks to help from Sakura, Sai, and Yamato. Utakata senses the chakra filling the atmosphere and terrain behaving oddly, and together with Naruto, they enter the cave where the anomaly is originating.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Master and Student
short_description: Hotaru, under the control of Shiranami's jutsu, uses the Forbidden Jutsu against Naruto and Utakata. Shiranami trembles with joy, having witnessed the power of the Forbidden Jutsu, while Hotaru is consumed by deep despair. Completely shunning herself, Hotaru breaks away from Shiranami's control.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Somber News
short_description: Returning from the mission, Naruto recollects his strange encounter with Itachi. What did the now deceased Itachi wish to tell him? As Naruto ponders this, Kakashi makes an abrupt visit. Without explanation Naruto is summoned to the Hokage residence, where he receives shocking news.

But what they see is the remains of the Leaf Village, leveled beyond recognition. Tsunade is enraged at the catastrophic casualties, but her chakra is already depleted from saving the villagers?
