name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Prophecy of the Great Lord Elder
short_description: In Mount Myoboku, Gerotora, Fukasaku, and the Great Lord Elder are debating whether to give Naruto the key to the Tetragram Seal left behind by Jiraiya, an act that could unleash the Nine Tails. Unable to come to a decision, they decide to summon Naruto.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Storage
short_description: At Mount Myoboku, Naruto prepares to store Gerotora within himself, but hesitates as it also holds the potential risk of unleashing the Nine Tails on the world. Elsewhere, Kabuto makes contact with Madara.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Five Kage's Decision
short_description: The denizens of the Leaf Village ready themselves for the coming of the Fourth Great Ninja War. Meanwhile, the Five Kage assemble in the Hidden Cloud Village to discuss where to hide the remaining two Jinchuriki.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Young Man and the Sea
short_description: Tsunade sends out Naruto under the guise of a top-secret mission to keep him hidden away from the Akatsuki. Unfortunately, Naruto, Yamato, Gai, and Aoba are stuck at the pier due to a report of a monster attacking ships. Wanting to set sail immediately, Naruto decides to take on the monster.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Ninja of Benisu
short_description: During their voyage, Naruto, Yamato, Gai, and Aoba stop at an island to recover from severe seasickness. There, they unexpectedly meet up with Sakura, Ino, and Choji, who are on an assignment to gather medical herbs for Tsunade.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Cursed Ghost Ship
short_description: Naruto?s ship is stranded at sea due to heavy fog, when another ship suddenly appears. Believing it to be a ghost ship, Naruto panics until he finds Hishaku, a boy sailor, on board the ship.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Battleship Island
short_description: Pirates living on an island resembling a battleship open fire on Naruto?s ship. Using Yamato?s Wood Style Jutsu, Naruto and the others escape into an undersea cave for cover, where they witness the evil done by the pirates.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Forgotten Island
short_description: Going after Guy, who was whisked away by a giant bird, Naruto, Yamato, and Aoba arrive on an island where they spot a young woman. While trying to gather information from the woman, Aoba learns of a horrible secret hidden on the island.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Fight! Rock Lee!
short_description: Guy recalls the time when he and Lee celebrated Lee learning the Hidden Lotus technique. Having partied too much, neither Guy nor Lee recalls what happened the day before, but Guy soon comes to the conclusion that he went wild and caused trouble.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Eat or Die! Musrhooms from Hell!
short_description: Making a stop at a nearby port to stock up on supplies, Naruto buys a rare mushroom from a vegetable merchant. But soon after they set sail for their next destination, Naruto and the other crewmembers find their ship infested with poisonous mushrooms.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Revenge of the Shadow Clones
short_description: Naruto?s Shadow Clones turn against their master after feeling mistreated and overworked. Unable to undo his jutsu, Naruto is taken captive by the Shadow Clones that demand to be treated better. Now a reluctant Yamato, Aoba, and Gai must try to save Naruto from the Shadow Clones.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Closed Route
short_description: As he prepares for the coming war, Shikamaru begins to feel the pressure of shouldering the lives of his friends. To help ease his mind, Shikaku sends his son on a mission to Mokuzu Island where Shikamaru meets up with Naruto.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Girls Get Together
short_description: Hinata's father Hiashi summons the Hyuga clan to discuss the role they will be playing in the upcoming Fourth Great Ninja War. Following the meeting, Hinata goes out to pay Kurenai a visit.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Naruto's Imposter
short_description: Naruto and the others encounter a thief who claims that he is Naruto Uzumaki of the Hidden Leaf. The real Naruto easily takes care of the imposter and hands him over to a ninja who was after the thief.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Naruto's Favorite Student
short_description: Konohamaru is eager to fight alongside his senior ninja in the coming war, but his young age prevents him from being assigned to the battlefield. Feeling that he is not taken seriously, Konohamaru goes asking people such as Sakura and Shikamaru for advice.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Kunoichi of Nadeshiko Village
short_description: Naruto meets two kunoichi ninja named Shizuka and Tokiwa from the Nadeshiko village who are seeking the student of Jiraiya. According to them, Jiraiya had made an agreement long ago with the previous leader of Nadeshiko village to have their students, Naruto and Shizuka, fight in battle.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Friends You Can Count On
short_description: At the Ninja Academy, Shino recounts the time when he failed to capture a wanted thief. Although Kiba and Hinata try to cheer him up, Shino still finds himself responsible for failing the mission and begins to question his place within the team.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Ah, My Hero Lady Tsunade!
short_description: Tenten is helping out Lee?s training to enhance his Eight Inner Gates. As Tenten watches over her friend, she recalls the days when she also worked hard to pursue her dreams of becoming a great kunoichi like the legendary Tsunade.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Sai's Day Off
short_description: While taking a walk through the Leaf Village, Sai comes across some kids who remind him of Sakura and Naruto. As he talks with one of the kids, Sai is amused when he is asked what the difference between a comrade and a friend is an answer he himself is not sure of.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Legendary Ino-Shika-Cho Trio
short_description: Ino, Choji, and Shikamaru run into Kosuke, an elderly genin who they saved in a previous mission. Praising their teamwork, Kosuke reveals that in the past their fathers, the previous Ino-Shika-Cho Trio, also saved him.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Kiba's Determination
short_description: Kiba trains hard to catch up to Naruto, who is now hailed as the hero of the Leaf Village, but with little success. Feeling desperate, Kiba asks Kakashi if he could train him. Although busy with his own mission, Kakashi respects Kiba's wish and summons his Ninja Hounds as a training partner.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Kakashi, My Eternal Rival!
short_description: As the Leaf ninja?s ship heads toward their final stop for supplies before entering the Land of Lightning, Yamato warns the crew to stay alert for enemies who could mimic both the appearance and chakra of their closest allies.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Naruto's Vow
short_description: During his final stop for supplies on an island in the Land of Water, Naruto runs into Akatsuchi and Kurotsuchi of the Hidden Stone, who are on an assignment to deliver a letter from the Tsuchikage addressed to the Mizukage.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Land Ahoy! Is this the Island of Paradise?
short_description: After a long voyage at sea, Naruto?s ship finally arrives at the island of its destination. Before everyone can rejoice, a giant squid attacks the ship. Fortunately, the crew is saved by Killer Bee, the Eight Tails? jinchuriki host.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Killer Bee and Motoi
short_description: Motoi warns Naruto that he is not yet ready to enter training to control the Tailed Beast. Undaunted, Naruto asks Motoi to tell him more about Killer Bee in the hopes of learning how another jinchuriki overcame the obstacle he is currently facing.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Next Challenge! Naruto vs. Nine Tails!
short_description: With Killer Bee as his new master, Naruto begins his training to control the power of a Tailed Beast. In order to do so, one must fight the Tailed Beast head on and absorb its chakra, converting it into one's own power.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Orange Spark
short_description: Inside his mind, Naruto continues his battle against Nine Tails to take control of its immense power. But exposure to Nine Tails? hatred begins to take its toll on Naruto, who finds himself becoming consumed by dark feelings of hate and despair.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Target: Nine Tails
short_description: Sixteen years ago, Fourth Hokage Minato Namikaze and his wife Kushina are expecting their first child, much to the delight of the young couple. But unbeknownst to everyone in the Hidden Leaf Village, a dangerous enemy plots to free the Nine Tails from Kushina, the Jinchuriki Host.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Fourth Hokage's Death Match!
short_description: Minato is forced to use his Flying Raijin jutsu and leave his wife Kushina behind to save their newborn son, Naruto, from a masked assailant. Realizing that Kushina was the enemy's target all along, Minato hides Naruto in a safe location and quickly rushes back to save his wife.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Thank You
short_description: Minato uses his Transportation Technique to move Nine Tails away from the Hidden Leaf Village. With little chakra remaining, both Minato and Kushina prepare to sacrifice their own lives to protect one another, the village, and most of all, their son, Naruto, from Nine Tails.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Battle in Paradise! The Odd Beast vs. The Monster!
short_description: Guy arrives at the Waterfall of Truth to help Naruto with his training. Instead he encounters Kisame, who has infiltrated the island to locate Naruto and Killer Bee. Guy tries to prevent Kisame from delivering intel to the Akatsuki, and a battle ensues between the two.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Man Named Kisame
short_description: Kisame?s escape is prevented thanks to Guy's efforts. Aoba enters Kisame?s mind to gather intel on the Akatsuki. In the process he learns about the ex-Hidden Mist ninja?s bloody past.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Angelic Herald of Death
short_description: Madara appears in the Hidden Rain Village seeking the corpse of Nagato and his Rinnegan. Anticipating his arrival, Konan engages in battle to protect her beloved friends and to stop Madara's plot to bring chaos into the world.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: S20E09
short_description: Madara uses the forbidden jutsu Izanagi to escape Konan’s Paper Bomb trap. Although she is mortally wounded, the will and hope left behind by her friends give Konan the strength to make a final attempt to defeat Madara.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Super Secret S- Rank Mission
short_description: The Leaf and Cloud ninja prepare to relocate Naruto and Bee, as the Akatsuki may already have knowledge of their location. Aoba assigns Naruto an S-rank mission to distract him from learning about their true mission: keeping the two Jinchuriki hidden from the enemy.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Artist Returns
short_description: Kabuto and a reanimated Deidara attempt to grab hold of the jinchuriki, but are stopped by the Tsuchikage, who has come to protect Naruto.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Assemble! Allied Shinobi Forces!
short_description: The Tsuchikage and his team manage to safeguard the Jinchuriki, but at the cost of losing Yamato to the enemy. Meanwhile, both the Allied Shinobi Forces and the Akatsuki complete their final preparations for battle. The Fourth Great Ninja War is about to begin!

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Meeting
short_description: A look back into the early years when Naruto and Sasuke first met and got to know each other.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Rivals
short_description: During the Chunin Exam, Sasuke witnesses Naruto's growth as a shinobi and comes to acknowledge his teammate as a rival that he doesn't want to lose to.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Rift
short_description: Sasuke's defeat to Gaara, and later Itachi, forces him to realize that he is not strong enough to get revenge against his older brother. To make matters worse, his jealousy of Naruto's growth deepens Sasuke's thirst for power.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Parting
short_description: Naruto is determined to save Sasuke, who has deserted the Hidden Leaf to join Orochimaru.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: For My Friend
short_description: The Allied Shinobi Forces are on standby, ready to confront Madara's army of reanimated shinobi and 100,000 White Zetsu. But distrust still exists among the Allied Shinobi Forces, who were once sworn enemies until recently.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: War Begins!
short_description: Kankuro's commando unit enters enemy territory to set up a stronghold for the Allied Shinobi Forces. They are immediately ambushed by the Akatsuki's own commando unit comprised of the reanimated Deidara and Sasori. The Fourth Great Ninja War has officially begun!

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Sai and Shin
short_description: The Allied Shinobi Forces' commando unit engages with the Akatsuki in the first wave of battle. During the fight, Sai is reunited with his brother Shin who has been reanimated and is now under the Akatsuki's control.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Secrets of the Reanimation Jutsu
short_description: Under the guidance of Killer Bee, Naruto enters the final stage of training to master the Tailed Beast Bomb, a Jinchuriki's most powerful technique. Meanwhile, Kabuto agrees to divulge the secret behind the Reanimation Jutsu to Madara as a token of trust.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: An Old Nemesis Returns
short_description: The commando unit is in hot water as they engage the reanimated Kekkei Genkai shinobi, which include Zabuza Momochi and Haku. Luckily, Kakashi and his unit arrive in time to assist them.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The First and Last Opponent
short_description: Kakashi and his unit devise a strategy to take on the Kekkei Genkai shinobi, but it's foiled by Kabuto, who uses the Reanimation Jutsu to summon the most powerful members of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Brilliant Military Advisor of the Hidden Leaf
short_description: The Akatsuki dispatch an army of powerful reanimated shinobi and White Zetsu across the war zone, causing chaos within the Allied Shinobi Forces' chain of command.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Battleground!
short_description: As Darui and his First Company engage an army of White Zetsu, the remaining forces must deal with reanimated shinobi comprised of their late friends?and their worst enemies.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Forbidden Words
short_description: Atsui, Samui, and Darui face off against Kinkaku and Ginkaku, the legendary brothers from the Hidden Cloud, feared even by the Raikage. Using the Five Treasured Tools of the Sage of Six Paths, the brothers quickly defeat Atsui and Samui, leaving Darui to fight on his own.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Golden Bonds
short_description: Darui manages to seal away Ginkaku. Fueled by the rage of losing his brother, Kinkaku transforms into a monster that resembles a jinchuriki's Tailed Beast State. Upon hearing this, the Raikage prepares to send out an item capable of containing this new threat.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: ROAD TO SAKURA
short_description: Ino sees Sakura falling from the sky. Although she manages to save her, the shock of the fall has left Sakura with amnesia. To help her remember, the Hidden Leaf ninja agree to play certain roles, according to how Sakura says she remembers them.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Mifune vs. Hanzo
short_description: Kankuro's Commando Unit is cornered by Hanzo's poison attack. Fortunately, Mifune and his Fifth Company arrive in time to provide assistance. Mifune challenges Hanzo to a one-on-one duel, and the battle between samurai and shinobi begins!

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: True Kindness
short_description: The Ino-Shika-Cho trio is ordered by Shikaku to take down the reanimated Asuma. Remembering Asuma's final words, Shikamaru and Ino are determined to stop their former teacher. But Choji's gentle nature prevents him from fighting Asuma, creating a disruption in the Ino-Shika-Cho formation.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Complete Ino-Shika-Cho Formation!
short_description: Choji is unable to attack Asuma and loses his will to fight. Ino and Shikamaru try to snap Choji out of his paralysis by reminding him what Asuma entrusted them with.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: A Message from the Heart
short_description: While training in Chakra Mode, Naruto senses the presence of the Nine Tails' chakra seeping from Kinkaku outside. Curious to find out what's happening, Naruto tries to leave the training room when Iruka suddenly steps in to stop him.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Attack of the Gedo Statue
short_description: The Allied Shinobi Forces are on the verge of winning the war when Madara Uchiha appears. Madara summons the giant Gedo Statue and unleashes its devastating power upon the Shinobi Forces.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Unison Sign
short_description: Naruto and Killer Bee rush to the battlefield when Nine Tails suddenly speaks to Naruto inside his mind. The Nine Tails questions Naruto's intent to end the hatred in the world and reminds him of how he was unable to save Sasuke.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Medic Ninja in Danger
short_description: Over at the Medical Unit camp, Sakura and the other medic ninja work nonstop to treat the wounded. Neji is there to recover from overusing his Byakugan. When several jonin medics are found dead, people suspect that a spy may have infiltrated their camp.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: White Zetsu's Trap
short_description: Kiba, Shino, and Hinata are sent to investigate an area where the Akatsuki are supposedly getting through. There, the three are ambushed by a White Zetsu and get separated. When they regroup, Shino suspects that a White Zetsu may be posing as one of them, creating distrust amongst the team.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Aesthetics of an Artist
short_description: Back at the Fifth Company's camp, Kurotsuchi attempts to negotiate with the captive Deidara to find out Kabuto's location, but is quickly rebuffed. When Deidara learns that Sasuke survived his ultimate art explosion, he plans an escape with help from a White Zetsu.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Allied Mom Force!
short_description: With many of the shinobi away serving in the Fourth Great Ninja War, the Leaf Village is left with just the mothers and children to protect it. Konohamaru is eager to guard the village but is quickly discouraged by the adults who tell him to just go about his day as usual.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: The Secret Origin of the Ultimate Tag Team!
short_description: Tsunade and the Raikage arrive to prevent Naruto and Killer Bee from joining the battle. But the two Kage fail to convince the Jinchuriki to turn back, forcing the Raikage to use extreme force.

name: Naruto Shippuden Uncut: Two Suns!
short_description: Fourth Raikage Ay attacks Naruto in an attempt to prevent the Jinchuriki from falling into Madara's hands. Ay is unwilling to listen to either Tsunade or Killer Bee's pleas to change his mind. Can Naruto convince the Raikage to let him join his friends in battle?

name: Steam Dev Days: Your Game's Back-End Item APIs

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Crybaby: Usagi's Beautiful Transformation
short_description: Usagi Tsukino is a 14-year-old schoolgirl who is very cheerful, but clumsy, and is always finding herself in unwanted trouble. One day Usagi meets a talking black cat named Luna, who reveals that dark forces are threatening the lives of the innocent and that Usagi has the power to stop them.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Punishment Awaits: The House Of Fortune Is The Monster Mansion
short_description: A new house of fortune opens up in the Juban District and quickly gains popularity for its accurate predictions. But soon, the customers who had their fortunes read begin to act violent, including Gurio Umino, a boy who has a crush on Usagi.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Mysterious Sleeping Sickness: Protect the Girls in Love
short_description: All the girls in town are tuning in to a late-night radio program called "Midnight Zero' that reads out love letters sent in by the listeners. Meanwhile, a strange sleeping sickness is plaguing the town that puts many people to sleep, including Ms. Haruda and Naru.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Learn How to Be Skinny from Usagi
short_description: Usagi is shocked to find out that she's gained weight from too much eating. Determined to get back into shape and fast, Usagi and her friends join a gym that advertises instant results for its members.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Scent of a Monster: Chanela Will Steal Your Love
short_description: Usagi asks her family if they can officially keep Luna as a pet, but her little brother Shingo strongly objects due to his fear of cats. Instead, Shingo brings home a pet Chanela, a creature that smells like perfume.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Protect the Melody of Love: Usagi Plays Cupid
short_description: One rainy day, Usagi bumps into Yusuke Amade, a famous musician who claims he is being chased by a monster. Realizing the man is telling the truth, Usagi and Luna decide to keep an eye on Yusuke by staking out the venue where he performs.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi Learns Her Lesson: Becoming a Star Is Hard Work
short_description: Usagi and Naru both dream of becoming a famous star like Mikan Shiratori, a graduate from their school. When the girls hear that Mikan is hosting a talent contest, they see their chance to achieve stardom.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Girl Genius Is a Monster: The Brainwashing Cram School of Horror
short_description: Usagi befriends Ami Mizuno, the school?s smartest girl, who has an IQ over 300. But Luna, who senses an unknown energy coming from Ami, suspects her of being a Monster.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's Disaster: Beware of the Clock of Confusion
short_description: Usagi and Ami go to the city to enjoy some shopping, where they find a clock store selling a clock that resembles Luna. Later that day, Usagi is happy to learn that her mother bought the exact same clock as a gift.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Cursed Bus: Enter Mars, the Guardian of Fire
short_description: Several people who take the bus near the Hikawa Shrine have started to go missing. Usagi and her friends decide to investigate by visiting the shrine, where they meet Rei Hino, a girl with strong spiritual powers.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi vs. Rei: Nightmare in Dream Land
short_description: The Sailor Guardians go to the Dream Land amusement park, where visitors have reportedly gone missing. The team splits into two groups with Rei pairing up with Usagi. But much to Rei's frustration, Usagi is more focused on playing than finding the missing people.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: I Want a Boyfriend: The Luxury Cruise Ship is a Trap
short_description: Rei goes off on a luxury cruise with Ami after winning tickets through the local lottery. Feeling left behind, Usagi sneaks aboard the ship disguised as a photographer.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Girls Unite: The End of Jadeite
short_description: Jadeite is given a final warning by Queen Beryl, who can no longer tolerate the general's continual failures. Realizing this is his last chance, Jadeite challenges the Sailor Guardians to a showdown at the airport.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: A New Enemy Appears: Nephrite's Evil Crest
short_description: Rui is a talented tennis player at Usagi's school, but Naru has noticed a dark change in her. Worried about their classmate, Naru and Usagi go to investigate at Rui's tennis school. Meanwhile, with Jadeite out of the picture, Nephrite has stepped in to collect human energy for the great ruler.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's Panic: Rei's First Date
short_description: Ami brings Usagi and Rei to her favorite park where the lake and peaceful environment make it a perfect dating spot. Unfortunately, the place is soon to be demolished to make room for an office building.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: A Girl's Dream: Usagi Becomes a Bride
short_description: The Juban District is having a contest to decide who can design the best handmade wedding dress. Upon learning that the prize will be a free luxury wedding reception, Usagi, Rei, and all the girls in town compete to design their own wedding dresses.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's a Model: The Flash of the Monster Camera
short_description: A young photographer named Kijin Shinokawa holds a modeling contest, and Usagi decides to enter. Mysteriously, all the girls who have entered the contest begin disappearing after Shinokawa photographs them!

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Shingo's Love: The Grieving Doll
short_description: Shingo's friend Mika gives him a doll that she won in a doll-making contest. But Shingo unintentionally breaks the doll and hurts Mika's feelings after being teased by boys at his school.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's Joy: A Love Letter from Tuxedo Mask
short_description: Usagi receives a love letter from Tuxedo Mask, stating that he'd like to meet her. But she soon finds out that all the girls in town received the same letter, including Naru, who believes that Tuxedo Mask is Masato Sanjoin.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Summer, the Beach, Youth and Ghosts
short_description: It's summertime, and the girls search for a vacation spot so they can get away and focus on training. Instead of finding a beautiful beach destination, they settle on an ominous-looking mansion that has a very eerie service staff.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Protect the Children's Dreams: Friendship Through Anime
short_description: Ami spots Nephrite on the street and follows him down to an animation studio that is making the upcoming Sailor V movie. Suspecting that Nephrite is up to no good, Ami calls Usagi and Rei so they can investigate the studio.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Romance Under the Moon: Usagi's First Kiss
short_description: The Kingdom of Diamonds is hosting a party at the embassy to reveal their royal treasure to the world. Believing that the treasure may be the Legendary Silver Crystal, both the Sailor Guardians and the Dark Kingdom crash the party to find out.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Wish upon a Star: Naru's First Love
short_description: Naru has fallen in love with Masato Sanjoin. Knowing that Sanjoin is really Nephrite, Usagi tries to convince Naru to give up on her feelings without having her learn the truth.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Naru's Tears: Nephrite Dies for Love
short_description: Nephrite uses Naru's feelings for him to lure out Sailor Moon and, in the process, succeeds in uncovering her true identity as Usagi Tsukino. But Nephrite's attempt to finish off Sailor Moon is cut short when he learns that Naru has been kidnapped by Zoisite.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Jupiter, the Powerful Girl in Love
short_description: A new girl named Makoto Kino transfers in to Usagi's school, but her tough attitude and appearance seem to scare away all the students. Usagi, however, finds Makoto to be very cool, and the two quickly become friends.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Restore Naru's Smile: Usagi's Friendship
short_description: The Sailor Guardians grow in strength with their newest member Sailor Jupiter joining the team. Sailor Moon is appointed team leader and is handed the Moon Stick, an item that can locate the seven Rainbow Crystals.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Crushing on Ami: The Boy Who Can See the Future
short_description: Usagi learns that a transfer student named Ryo Urawa seems to have a crush on Ami and tries to help him out. But Ryo, who secretly possesses the ability to foresee the future, finds out that he is destined to fight Ami as a monster.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Painting of Love: Usagi and Mamoru Get Closer?
short_description: Usagi and Naru attend an art exhibit by Yumemi Yumeno, whose works are known for helping people find love. Usagi is surprised when she and Mamoru, who also happen to be at the exhibit, are both asked by Yumemi to become models for her latest painting.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Total Chaos: The Messy Love Rectangle
short_description: Usagi and Makoto are shocked to discover that their crush Motoki has a girlfriend named Reika. However, Motoki and Reika?s relationship is in jeopardy due to Reika being offered a chance to study abroad in Africa.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Grandpa Loses Control: Rei in Danger
short_description: Grandpa Hino has become emotionally unstable, with angry outbursts or sudden bouts of tears, causing Rei to become worried. Grandpa Hino's new apprentice Yuichiro tries to cheer up Rei by explaining that her grandfather's odd behavior is because of the weather.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Love and Chased: Luna's Worst Day Ever
short_description: Usagi and her friends go meet a young girl who they believe is the holder of the seventh and final Rainbow Crystal. Their suspicions are confirmed when Zoisite comes after the girl.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Umino's Resolve: I'll Protect Naru
short_description: Umino seems to have fallen in love with Naru. Unfortunately, Naru only considers Umino a friend, so Usagi decides to play Cupid by getting free tickets to the amusement park and urges them to go on a date together.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Enter Venus, the Last Sailor Guardian
short_description: When the exploits of a Sailor Moon imposter become quite a sensation on the streets, the real Sailor Guardians step in to investigate. They soon learn that the whole thing is a trap set up by the Dark Kingdom to lure out Tuxedo Mask and seize the Rainbow Crystals that he possesses.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Shining Silver Crystal: The Moon Princess Appears
short_description: Now that Sailor V, otherwise known as Sailor Venus, has joined the team, all the Sailor Guardians are finally together! Meanwhile, Zoisite has discovered that Tuxedo Mask is actually Mamoru Chiba and challenges him to a showdown for possession of the Rainbow Crystals.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Returning Memories: Usagi and Mamoru's Past
short_description: Tuxedo Mask is fatally wounded while protecting Sailor Moon. Responding to Sailor Moon's tears, the seven Rainbow Crystals gather to form the Legendary Silver Crystal. In the process Sailor Moon is transformed into Serenity, the Moon Princess that everyone has been searching for.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's Confusion: Is Tuxedo Mask Evil?
short_description: Usagi is haunted by dreams of her past life and Tuxedo Mask, who has been abducted by the Dark Kingdom. A concerned Minako decides to take Usagi to a popular hair salon in the Juban District, hoping it will help take her friend?s mind off of her recent worries.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Let's Become a Princess: Usagi's Bizarre Training
short_description: Recently, girls from rich families have been attending the Princess Seminar at the Rose Mansion. Usagi decides to take the course in order to become more princess-like, and the other Sailor Guardians join her.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Snow, the Mountains, Friendship and Monsters
short_description: Usagi and her friends go to a ski resort to participate in the Moon Princess Contest, unaware that it's part of Kunzite's plan to find and eliminate the real Moon Princess. During the ski contest, Usagi and Rei end up falling for the monster's trap and get buried in the snow.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Paired with a Monster: Mako, the Ice Skating Queen
short_description: To commemorate the opening of the new skating rink, former Olympic figure-skating gold medalists Janelyn and Misha offer to coach groups of five girls, free of charge. Usagi and her friends sense that this is some kind of trap and decide to look into it.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: The Legendary Lake Yokai: The Bond of Usagi's Family
short_description: Usagi goes on a family vacation to the hot springs, where she is unexpectedly reunited with Mamoru. But due to the Dark Kingdom's brainwashing, Mamoru no longer remembers Usagi or even who he really is.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: I Won't Run Away from Love Anymore: Ami vs. Mamoru
short_description: The Dark Kingdom is trying once again to revive the Seven Great Monsters that Sailor Moon had previously defeated and restored back to humans. With five of them already under enemy hands, Sailor Mercury and Jupiter scramble to find and protect Ryo Urawa, while Moon, Mars and Venus stay behind.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Sailor Venus's Past: Minako's Tragic Love?
short_description: Minako receives a surprise visit from Katarina, an Interpol officer from the UK and Minako's former partner while she was fighting crime in London as Sailor V. Minako looked up to Katarina like a real sister, and the two worked to solve many cases together until a tragic incident.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi Abandoned: The Falling-Out of the Sailor Guardians
short_description: Sailor Moon and the other Sailor Guardians appear to have a falling-out during one of their missions. But this is actually part of a plan to draw the Dark Kingdom's attention so that they can locate the enemy's hideout.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's Awakening: A Message from the Distant Past
short_description: Sailor Venus finally finds the entrance to the Dark Kingdom's hideout. The Sailor Guardians rush in, only to fall into Kunzite's trap, which hurls them into the past. When they wake up, the girls find themselves in a world called Silver Millennium.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Death of the Sailor Guardians: The Tragic Final Battle
short_description: In order to defeat Queen Beryl, the Sailor Guardians set out for the Dark Kingdom's hideout located in the Arctic Circle. Having anticipated their arrival, Queen Beryl sends out the DD Girls, who ambush the Sailor Guardians.

name: Sailor Moon Season 1: Usagi's Eternal Wish: A Brand New Life
short_description: Overcoming the death of her friends, Sailor Moon finally comes face to face with Queen Beryl and Endymion. Sailor Moon attempts to free Endymion from Queen Beryl's control by using the Silver Crystal, but the brainwashing proves too powerful to be undone.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Moon Returns: The Mysterious Aliens Appear
short_description: Two months have passed since the Sailor Guardians defeated the Dark Kingdom. Having lost all memory of being Sailor Moon, Usagi now lives her life as an ordinary girl.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: For Love and for Justice: Sailor Guardians Once Again?
short_description: Sailor Moon finds herself facing new enemies from outer space, who call themselves Ail and An. The two aliens disguise themselves as humans to go after other human energy.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: For Whom Is the White Rose? The Moonlight Knight Appears
short_description: Usagi, Mako, and Ami see a boy being attacked by one of Ail and An?s Cardian monsters. To Mako?s surprise, the boy turns out to be her childhood friend Shinozaki.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Usagi's Crisis: The Tiara Stops Working
short_description: Usagi goes to a virtual reality arcade that has just opened up in the Juban District, where she unexpectedly runs into Mamoru, as well as Seijuro and Natsumi.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: A New Transformation: Usagi's Power-Up
short_description: Usagi and her friends are enjoying the cherry blossoms, which are in full bloom, when the Cardian Leshy attacks them. During the fight, the Sailor Guardians are caught, and Sailor Moon loses her power to transform.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: The Targeted Kindergarteners: Venus to the Rescue
short_description: Minako befriends a little girl named Mie who is a huge fan of Sailor Moon. Meanwhile, Ail and An send a Cardian to steal energy from young children

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Mamoru and Usagi's Babysitting Mayhem
short_description: Usagi and Mamoru find themselves looking after a baby boy while his mother is recovering from having her energy stolen by a Cardian.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: The School Festival Is for Me?! Queen Rei's Song
short_description: A school festival is going to be held at T.A. Girls' Academy, which Rei attends. When Usagi and Ami go to check up on her, they find Rei busy overseeing the setup and events.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Is Seijuro the Moonlight Knight? Mako on Fire
short_description: Ami and Makoto are trying to figure out who exactly the Moonlight Knight is. Suspecting that Seijuro and the Moonlight Knight may be the same person, Makoto volunteers to investigate by getting closer to Seijuro.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Steal a Kiss from Mamoru: An's Project Snow White
short_description: Usagi and the girls get into an argument over who gets to play Snow White in the upcoming play with Mamoru. After drawing straws, Natsumi gets the part, much to Usagi's frustration.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: After-School Trouble: Usagi Is a Target
short_description: Usagi and Natsumi both get detention after angering Ms. Haruna during class. The two start working on their assignment when a Cardian suddenly shows up

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Disconnecting Love: The Raging Makai Tree
short_description: Ail and An learn that the Makai Tree is beginning to die from lack of energy. Meanwhile, Usagi and her friends visit Seijuro and Natsumi's apartment after hearing that Natsumi is not feeling well.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: True Love Awakens: The Makai Tree's Secret
short_description: While visiting Seijuro and Natsumi's apartment, Usagi and Mamoru come under attack by the Makai Tree.

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Angel or Devil? The Mysterious Girl from the Sky

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Dispute Over Love: Minako and Makoto's Conflict

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Usagi's Parental Love: The Curry Romance Triangle

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: The Beach, the Island and a Vacation: The Guardian's Break

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Protect Chibi-Usa: Clash of the Ten Warriors

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: For Friendship: Ami vs. Bertheir

name: Sailor Moon R Season 2: Rubeus the Heartless: The Tragic Sisters

short_description: Momo recalls her days at the Soul Reaper Academy, where she met and trained in the World of the Living...

name: Bleach: Bleach 47
short_description: Momo, Renji and Kira have all escaped.

name: Bleach: Bleach 48
short_description: In her holding cell, Rukia has a dream that she believes is to help her prepare for the next day's events.

name: Bleach: Bleach 49
short_description: In her dream, Rukia recalls her time spent training under Lieutenant Kaien and Captain Ukitate.

name: Bleach: Bleach 50
short_description: In the world of the living, Don Kanonji tries to up the ratings of his television show by recruiting Kon as the mascot of his show.

name: Bleach: Bleach 51
short_description: Preparations are underway for Rukia's execution...

name: Bleach: Bleach 52
short_description: While Ichigo continues his Bankai training, Renji emerges from his to try and save Rukia.

name: Bleach: Bleach 53
short_description: As Rukia Kuchiki is being lead to her execution, she is stopped by the ever-devious Gin Ichimaru. Just when Rukia has prepared herself for death, her concentration is broken by Gin's offer to let her live...

name: Bleach: Bleach 54
short_description: Rukia stands on the Sokyoku at the brink of her execution, not knowing that help is on the way.

name: Bleach: Bleach 55
short_description: While Renji hurries to get Rukia out of harm's way, Ichigo stays behind to hold off Byakuya Kuchiki.

name: Bleach: Bleach 56
short_description: Captain Ukitake and Captain Kyoraku face the punishment meted out by Head Captain Yamamoto's Zanpakuto.

name: Bleach: Bleach 57
short_description: Fueled by anger and feelings of abandonment and betrayal, Soi Fon persists in her attempt to destroy her former master Yoruichi Shihouin, but her abilities may be hampered by her cocksure attitude.

name: Bleach: Bleach 58
short_description: The fierce battle between Ichigo and Captain Byakuya rages on. Ichigo taunts Byakuya and demands that he use his Bankai against him...

name: Bleach: Bleach 59
short_description: Byakuya Kuchiki may have been impressed by the power exerted by Ichigo, the substitute Soul Reaper, but he's not done fighting yet.

name: Bleach: Bleach 60
short_description: Central 46 is the highest judicial body in the Soul Society. After breaking into Central 46, Captain Hitsugaya and Rangiku discover that the forty Sages and six Judges were slaughtered days earlier.

name: Bleach: Bleach 61
short_description: After defeating Hitsugaya, Captain Aizen heads for the Execution Grounds. Renji is dumbfounded as he finds himself facing Captains Aizen, Ichimaru, and Tossen at Sokyoku hill...

name: Bleach: Bleach 62
short_description: Furious after hearing the news of the defection of three captains, Sajin Komamura arrives at the Sokyoku ready to beat the treachery out of Aizen and his lackeys.

name: Bleach: Bleach 63
short_description: Peace returns as the Soul Society recuperates from the deep wounds left by the treachery of Captain Aizen and his partners in crime. Captain Komamura and Lieutenant Hisagi visit the graves of fallen comrades...

name: Bleach: Bleach 64
short_description: Ichigo and his friends have returned from the Soul Society and are finally able to get back to their "normal" lives.

name: Bleach: Bleach 65
short_description: Ichigo and his friends meet at school and set out to look for Orihime the day after her disappearance.

name: Bleach: Bleach 66
short_description: After Chad's kidnapping, Ichigo and the others go to Urahara to explain their predicament.

name: Bleach: Bleach 67
short_description: Chad and Orihime are rescued, but when Lirin tells them that one of their friends has been replaced by an impostor, they realize that the game is not over.

name: Bleach: Bleach 68
short_description: Lirin sets in place a giant gate that begins to devour everything in Karakura Town. The only way to have Chad released and save the town is to destroy the gate.

name: Bleach: Bleach 69
short_description: New information has come to light regarding an unusual race known as Bounts. Kisuke Urahara explains that Bounts are beings that gain eternal life by absorbing the souls of humans.

name: Bleach: Bleach 70
short_description: Ichigo and Lirin find themselves in a pinch when they are attacked by the Bount Yoshino Soma and her Doll, Goethe.

name: Bleach: Bleach 71
short_description: Ichigo, Rukia, Orihime, Chad, and Uryu surround the Bount Ryo Udagawa, but they find themselves at a slight disadvantage when he releases the immense power of his Doll, Friede.

name: Bleach: Bleach 72
short_description: Uryu, who is seriously hurt in the Bount attack, is hospitalized at Karakura Hospital. Ichigo and the others, knowing that Quincys are being targeted, decide to protect Uryu in the hospital...

name: Bleach: Bleach 73
short_description: Ichigo and the others run from the twin Bounts, Ho and Ban, who have attacked them at the hospital...

name: Bleach: Bleach 74
short_description: Uryu was knocked unconscious during Ho and Ban's attack but was saved by Yoshino...

name: Bleach: Bleach 75
short_description: Uryu is listening to the history of the Bounts at Yoshino's hideout when Koga, a Bount, attacks. Uryu and Yoshino battle Koga's Steel Doll Dalk, but Yoshino's flame Goethe is no match for the steel Dalk...

name: Bleach: Bleach 76
short_description: Ichigo, Rukia, Lirin, Noba, and Kurodo enter the Bount mansion and for the first time come face to face with Jin Kariya and the other Bounts?

name: Bleach: Bleach 77
short_description: Udagawa, who betrayed Jin Kariya, is brought down by former Squad 11 Soul Reaper Maki Ichinose. Then Ichinose turns his zanpakuto onto Ichigo...

name: Bleach: Bleach 78
short_description: Thanks to Yoruichi's surprise attack, Ichigo and his cohorts barely manage to escape Jin Kariya's mansion. Uryu and Yoshino have sustained serious injuries and are treated at Urahara's Shop...

name: Bleach: Bleach 79
short_description: Yoshino leaves the Urahara's Shop at the crack of dawn. Yoshino is aware of Jin Kariya's ambition and is determined to stop him at the risk of her life...

name: Inuyasha: The Girl Who Overcame Time?and the Boy Who Was Just Overcome
short_description: In feudal Japan, the half demon Inuyasha was sealed away by the priestess Kikyo. Many years later he is revived by Kagome, who has slipped through time from the present day. Kagome is surprised when the sacred Shikon Jewel, which makes demons stronger, emerges from a cut on her body.

name: Inuyasha: Seekers of the Sacred Jewel

name: Inuyasha: Down the Rabbit Hole and Back Again
short_description: Kagome has the ability to see pieces of the Shikon Jewel. Inuyasha has the power to defeat demons. Both of their powers are needed to gather the shards of the jewel that were scattered, but the two don't get along. The demon Yura, who is after the jewel, manipulates villagers to attack Inuyasha.

name: Inuyasha: Yura of the Demon-Hair
short_description: Kagome has returned to the present day and is relaxing in her home when Inuyasha comes looking for her. Some of Yura's demonic hair is on his body. Kagome and Inuyasha return to feudal Japan to exterminate the Yura of the hair.

name: Inuyasha: Aristocratic Assassin, Sesshomaru
short_description: Kagome learns that Inuyasha is a half demon, born of a human mother and a dog demon. Inuyasha's half brother Sesshomaru appears, looking for the tomb of their father. In order to manipulate Inuyasha, he brings Inuyasha's dead human mother with him.

name: Inuyasha: Tetsusaiga, the Phantom Sword
short_description: The muonna makes Inuyasha reveal the location of his father's grave. Sesshomaru removes Inuyasha's right eye (the black pearl) and opens the entrance to the grave. Kagome is angered by Sesshomaru's cruelty. She goes with Inuyasha after Sesshomaru.

name: Inuyasha: Showdown! Inuyasha vs. Sesshomaru
short_description: Kagome is able to pull out the Tetsusaiga. Sesshomaru tries to kill her, and Inuyasha is angered and fights to protect Kagome. His will to protect a human changes the Tetsusaiga into its true form, a fang sword.

name: Inuyasha: The Toad Who Would Be Prince
short_description: In the Kai Province, there is a young samurai named Nobunaga. He is a clumsy but earnest young man. He has heard rumors about the man that the the princess, his childhood friend, has married. Nobunaga tries to save the lord of the castle who is possessed by a toad demon.

name: Inuyasha: Shippo and the Thunder Brothers
short_description: Shippo is a demon fox whose father was killed by the the Thunder Brothers: Hiten and Manten. He steals the Shikon Jewel shards from Kagome so that he can avenge his father.

name: Inuyasha: Phantom Showdown The Thunder Brothers vs. Tetsusaiga
short_description: Inuyasha goes to save Kagome from Manten. Hiten devours the sacred jewel shard that Manten had and absorbs his demon powers. Hiten attacks Inuyasha with his Raigekijin. Inuyasha is in trouble and defends himself with the scabbard of the Tetsusaiga.

name: Inuyasha: Terror of the Ancient Noh Mask
short_description: Kagome has returned to the present day to take a test. As she does, a noh mask, the Mask of Flesh, begins a violent search for the Shikon Jewel shards. Kagome's younger brother, Sota, tries hard to call Inuyasha to come to Kagome's rescue.

name: Inuyasha: The Soul Piper and the Mischievous Little Soul
short_description: Kagome sees a Soul Piper, a demon that consoles the spirits of children. She helps Mayu, a girl who is about to become an evil spirit, to pass on.

name: Inuyasha: The Mystery of the New Moon and the Black-haired Inuyasha
short_description: Half demon Inuyasha's secret is that he becomes human once a month. That day, Inuyasha and the gang meet Nazuna and stay at a mountain temple. They fall into Kumogashira's trap and the sacred jewel shards are taken away from them. Inuyasha is injected with poison!

name: Inuyasha: Kikyo's Stolen Ashes
short_description: The ogress, Urasue, robs the grave of Kikyo, the priestess who sealed away Inuyasha fifty years ago. She revives Kikyo's body using the ashes of Kikyo's bones and soil from Kikyo's grave. But Kikyo's soul has already been reincarnated in a different body.

name: Inuyasha: Return of the Tragic Priestess, Kikyo
short_description: Kikyo is revived when Kagome's soul flows into her. She tries to kill Inuyasha, but Kagome takes back her soul. Fifty years ago, Kikyo wanted Inuyasha to use the Shikon Jewel to become human. But on the day of their promise, someone who looked like Inuyasha fatally injured Kikyo.

name: Inuyasha: Mystical Hand of the Amorous Monk, Miroku
short_description: Miroku, a womanizing delinquent priest, has been collecting Shikon Jewel shards and steals Kagome's shards. Inuyasha tracks him down and confronts Miroku to get the shards back. Miroku fights back with his priestly powers and the wind tunnel in his hand that he was cursed with.

name: Inuyasha: The Cursed Ink of the Hell-Painter
short_description: Kotatsu, a painter, sees a dream in which he becomes successful by controlling an army of ogres drawn with ink that has a sacred jewel shard in it. Miroku, Inuyasha and the others become involved in protecting the princess that Kotatsu is in love with.

name: Inuyasha: Naraku and Sesshomaru Join Forces
short_description: Naraku appears before Sesshomaru and lends him an arm with a sacred jewel shard embedded in it. Sesshomaru attaches the arm to himself and appears before Inuyasha and the gang to steal the Tetsusaiga.

name: Inuyasha: Go Back to Your Own Time, Kagome!
short_description: Sesshomaru wields the Tetsusaiga with his borrowed arm against Inuyasha, who fights back with his scabbard. When the two strike each other at the same time, Inuyasha gets up close to Sesshomaru, rips off his arm, and gets back the Tetsusaiga.

name: Inuyasha: Despicable Villain! The Mystery of Onigumo!
short_description: Kagome has her sacred jewel shards taken away from her and is returned to the present day, unable to return to feudal Japan. Back to her normal life, she agrees to go on a date with Hojo. Meanwhile, Inuyasha and the gang try to find out more about the mysterious Naraku.

name: Inuyasha: Naraku's True Identity Unveiled
short_description: Kagome returns to the shrine in the middle of her date with Hojo. She senses the presence of the Shikon Jewel shards and returns to feudal Japan. Naraku reveals that fifty years ago, Onigumo was in love with Kikyo.

name: Inuyasha: A Wicked Smile; Kikyo's Wandering Soul
short_description: Kikyo, who was brought back to life, is living as a priestess. A monk, who realizes that Kikyo is dead, tries to make Kikyo pass on, but Kikyo ends up killing him. Inuyasha saves the monk's disciples and runs to Kikyo when he hears the priestess's name.

name: Inuyasha: Kagome's Voice and Kikyo's Kiss
short_description: Kikyo paralyzes Kagome. Inuyasha appears before her. Kikyo has been gathering the souls of dead girls. She vents her grudge against Inuyasha. Inuyasha reveals that he has never forgotten her. When Inuyasha kisses Kikyo, Kikyo tries to drag him to hell.

name: Inuyasha: Enter Sango, the Demon Slayer

name: Inuyasha: Naraku?s Insidious Plot

name: Inuyasha: The Secret of the Sacred Jewel Revealed!

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Introduction & Overview
short_description: Take a tour of the header info, Synth and Effects pages and their sections, and the Preview Ribbon.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Using Controls
short_description: Discover the differences between faders, knobs, selectors and range controls. PC keyboard and scroll wheel tips included.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Oscillators - Waveforms
short_description: This video covers the selection area menu items for waves, transpose, octave, sync mode and grouping.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Oscillators - Shapers
short_description: Take a look at how to shape a wave using the numerous available transformation parameters and route audio through the two filter busses.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Oscillators - Perform Mode
short_description: Get a tour of the powerful pitch bend parameters and portamento mode. Analog parameters and the X-Y pad are explained as well.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Filter Types
short_description: he filters types are explained and demonstrated. The filters types are explained and demonstrated. The cutoff and resonance filters are demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Filter Controls
short_description: Reso Boost and signal routing are covered. The Dual and Parallel settings are explained.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Envelope Generators
short_description: The Envelope Generator section is explained. Amplifier and Pitch are demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: LFO Pt. 1
short_description: The Low Frequency Oscillator (LFO) section is explained. This video covers all parameters and controls when using one of the two available waves.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: LFO Pt. 2
short_description: The addition of the second wave is explored. The modes to combine wave 1 and wave 2 are covered.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Modulation Matrix Pt. 1
short_description: Get a tour on how to use Source, Range and Destination parameters to use an LFO and an EG for modulation.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Modulation Matrix Pt. 2
short_description: This second video looks at Curve and Control menu items. Various routing possibilities are demonstrated using Curve and Control to affect the destination modulation.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Algorithmic Mode
short_description: This first video looks at the algorithmic patterns created by playing multiple notes. Octave, Sort, Sync, Speed, Mode, Velocity and Length are demonstrated along with the Groove features.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: MIDI Mode
short_description: This second video looks at the MIDI arpeggio and Gate patterns in Z3TA+ 2's collection. Export, import, and edit are demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Distortion
short_description: Learn how to set up a filter per voice, all filters, or both. Modes and destinations are covered along with tone, gain and the Decimator.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Modulation
short_description: Chorus, Flanger and Phaser are all available and explained. All the parameters are explained and demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Compressor
short_description: The Compressor threshold, ratio and gain are explained and the modes are demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Delay
short_description: The Delay has three separate delays that work in series. Learn the modes, EQ, feedback and stereo placement.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Reverb
short_description: The Reverb room modes, size, damping, EQ and level are demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: EQ & Simulator
short_description: The modes for the 7 band equalizer are demonstrated as are the Simulator modes.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Automation
short_description: This video covers recording and playing back Z3TA+ 2 parameters via Track Based Automation.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: MIDI Learn
short_description: The powerful MIDI learn features are covered. Mapping the controller, creating online and offline automation and playback are demonstrated.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: User Waveforms & Program Menu
short_description: Loading custom waveforms in the oscillator and LFO sections are covered. The Program menu items are covered as well.

name: Z3TA+ 2 Explained - Groove3: Options Menu
short_description: The Options menu items are covered in detail.
